steps.instruction: Wash 1/2 cup of basmati rice in several changes of cold water.
Drain the rice and put it in a pot.
Add 2 cups of water, 1 bay leaf and 4 peppercorns.
Add 1 piece of cinnamon stick, 2 whole cloves and salt to taste.
Bring the pot to a boil.
Lower to medium-low, cover and cook for 12 minutes.
steps.spoken: Lower the heat to medium-low, cover and cook for about 12 minutes, until all the water is gone and the rice grains are tender but separate.

steps.instruction: Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a pan.
Add 1 cup of diced firm tofu to the oil.
Fry the tofu a few minutes on each side.
Scoop the tofu out of the oil and set it aside.
Add 2 tablespoons each of almonds and cashews, and 1 tablespoon of raisins.
Fry until the nuts are golden brown and the raisins are plump.
Take the pan off the heat.
Put the rice in a serving bowl and fluff it gently with a fork.
Gently fold in the tofu and nuts and mix well.
